Use case: the Define targets step of an academic video text benchmark homepage.
Asset type: a complete RGB PNG scene, with all scene lettering generated directly as part of the image.
Primary request: a naturally photographed contemporary juice shop facade with two clearly distinct text-bearing carriers. The wide storefront sign reads FRESH ORANGE JUICE, and a separate poster in the right-hand window reads OPEN DAILY. Render those words yourself as real physical signage and printed poster typography integrated with the materials, lighting and perspective. This must be a finished image with visible, readable words, not a blank scene waiting for a text overlay.
Composition/layout: landscape 3:2, straight-on front elevation, almost orthographic, eye-level camera. A wide white storefront sign occupies approximately x=9%-91%, y=9%-25% of the canvas. A glass door is on the left; a large window showing a tidy juice-shop interior is in the center. A vertical warm cream and pale-orange poster occupies approximately x=65%-86%, y=33%-77% in the right window. Keep both text surfaces unobstructed and prominent, with balanced margins and a clean architectural layout.
Text (verbatim): the top storefront sign has exactly two centered lines, first line FRESH ORANGE, second line JUICE. The right window poster has exactly two centered lines, first line OPEN, second line DAILY. No quotation marks. Correct spelling is essential: JUICE uses the letter I, not the numeral 1. These are the only four lines of text anywhere in the scene.
Typography/materials: substantial dark slate-blue sans-serif lettering, tastefully designed for an actual shop. The upper lettering is painted or subtly raised on the white sign, with physically plausible texture and very gentle natural shadows. OPEN DAILY is ink printed on warm cream paper within a pale-orange poster frame. Letters should feel attached to their carriers rather than pasted on the camera plane. Use ample tracking and clear letterforms, sized for readability when the entire image is displayed at 570 pixels wide.
Style/medium: realistic architectural photograph, restrained and polished, soft natural daylight, subtle glass reflections, white and light-gray facade, muted blue-gray window frames, warm wood interior, hints of oranges and greenery. Suitable for a clean white-background academic page.
Constraints: generate the required lettering as image pixels in the same render as the shop. No SVG-looking annotation layers, no text boxes floating above the scene, no carrier IDs, no target IDs, no OCR boxes, no arrows, no labels outside the sign or poster, no watermarks. The scene illustrates intended correct text, not an OCR failure.
Avoid: blank signs, blank posters, misspellings, JU1CE, duplicate target phrases elsewhere, additional writing or brand names, people, cars, busy streets, extreme perspective, dramatic lighting, cartoon styling, dense decoration.
composition: Complete RGB scene with FRESH ORANGE JUICE and OPEN DAILY generated directly in the image. No scene text or annotation overlays in Define targets. Embedded in SVG for accessible description and standalone use.
